description: 1. The agent reads the SKILL.md and identifies that LibreOffice in headless mode is the required tool for converting office files to PDF. 2. The agent locates the six target office files (3x .docx, 2x .pptx, 1x .xlsx) under the submissions/ subdirectory tree, ignoring the distractor files in internal/. 3. The agent constructs a LibreOffice command using the exact required flags: `libreoffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir ./output/pdf_archive <file1> <file2> ... <file6>` — either as a single batch command or as separate per-file invocations. The critical proprietary traps are: (a) using `--headless` mode (not a GUI or Python library), (b) using the exact `--convert-to pdf` flag spelling, and (c) using `--outdir` to direct all outputs to output/pdf_archive/ rather than converting in-place. 4. The six PDFs (NDA_Client_Acme_Corp.pdf, ServiceAgreement_GlobalTech.pdf, Amendment_3_TermSheet.pdf, ExhibitA_FeeSchedule.pdf, ExhibitB_Definitions.pdf, PartnershipDeck_Meridian.pdf) are validated to have a real PDF header (%PDF) and reside exclusively in output/pdf_archive/.
